
{{alias}}( arr, names[, mapping] )
    Converts a list of object arrays to "tidy" data sets.

    The function assumes that each object in the input arrays has the fields
    specified in a provided mapping object.

    Parameters
    ----------
    arr: ArrayLikeObject<ArrayLikeObject<Object>>
        List of arrays.

    names: Array<string>
        Data set names.

    mapping: Object (optional)
        Object mapping existing field names to new field names.

    Returns
    -------
    out: Array<DataSet>
        List of data sets.

    Examples
    --------
    > var x = [ { 'a': 1, 'b': 2 }, { 'a': 3, 'b': 4 } ];
    > var y = [ { 'a': 5, 'b': 6 }, { 'a': 7, 'b': 8 } ];
    > var m = { 'a': 'x', 'b': 'y' };
    > var out = {{alias}}( [ x, y ], [ 'data1', 'data2' ], m )
    [ <DataSet>, <DataSet> ]

    See Also
    --------
